connector.name: Creator Api MCP
connector.registryDescription: Native OnlyFans and Fansly access as MCP tools. One CreatorAPI key.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.creator-api.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package creator-api-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the creator-api account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CREATOR_API_KEY
env.description: Your ca_live_ CreatorAPI key. Get one free at https://creator-api.com/signup

env.name: CREATOR_API_ENABLE_WRITES
env.description: Set to 1 to register native_write (outbound messages). Off by default.
